_key.description: Variant key and coding variant key joined by an underscore. Hashed with SHA-256 when the composite would exceed the 254-character key limit.

_to.description: Handle of the coding consequence on one transcript.

source.description: dbNSFP release this record was read from.

name.description: Predicate for the genomic-variant to coding-consequence direction.

inverse_name.description: Predicate for the coding-consequence to genomic-variant direction.

chr.description: Chromosome of the variant as dbNSFP records it, without a chr prefix.

pos.description: Start of the variant on GRCh38, converted from dbNSFP's 1-based coordinate to 0-based.

ref.description: Reference allele of the genomic variant.

alt.description: Alternate allele of the genomic variant.
